title: What Is Your Future Career?
你未来的职业是什么？

sentences: Maria and Jessica are classmates.
玛丽亚和杰西卡是同学。
They need to finish an art project.
他们需要完成一个艺术项目。
On Sunday they went to an exhibition of the famous painter and artist Picasso and found some materials.
周日他们去了著名画家和艺术家毕加索的展览，并找到了一些材料。
Maria took some beautiful pictures with her camera.
玛丽亚用相机拍了一些漂亮的照片。
"Wow, good job.
「哇，做得好。
What is your future career?
你未来的职业是什么？
A photographer, right?" asked Jessica curiously.
摄影师，对吗？」杰西卡好奇地问。
"No.
My mother is a dancer.
我妈妈是舞蹈家。
She dances well.
她跳舞很好。
When I was a child, I wanted to be a dancer like her.
当我还是个孩子时，我想像她一样成为舞蹈家。
But when I grow up, I know that my father and his colleagues' work is respected by people and they can save lots of people's lives.
但当我长大后，我知道我父亲和他同事的工作受到人们的尊敬，他们可以拯救很多人的生命。
So now I want to be a rescue pilot like them," answered Maria.
所以现在我想像他们一样成为救援飞行员，」玛丽亚回答。
Then she added, "I want to tell you the story about my parents.
然后她补充说：「我想告诉你关于我父母的故事。
They have a common interest in music.
他们对音乐有共同的兴趣。
They both like pop, hip hop, jazz and rap.
他们都喜欢流行、嘻哈、爵士和说唱。
They first met at a concert of Beyonce.
他们第一次见面是在碧昂丝的音乐会上。
When watching her shows, they knew each other.
看她的演出时，他们认识了彼此。
Finally, they got married."
最后，他们结婚了。」
"Oh, your parents' story sounds like a love comedy.
「哦，你父母的故事听起来像爱情喜剧。
Well, my father used to be a mechanic, but he is an engineer.
嗯，我父亲以前是机械师，但现在是工程师。
Although he cannot earn much money like a businessman or an actor, he can get enough for us to have a comfortable life.
虽然他赚的钱不像商人或演员那么多，但他赚的钱足够让我们过上舒适的生活。
I used to dream of being a writer or journalist to record common people's lives.
我过去梦想成为作家或记者来记录普通人的生活。
However, after I saw my grandfather recover from a serious illness because of the help offered by doctors and nurses, I decided to become a doctor," answered Jessica.
然而，看到我祖父在医生和护士的帮助下从重病中康复后，我决定成为一名医生，」杰西卡回答。
Maria looked very excited and said, "That's great!
玛丽亚看起来很兴奋，说：「那太好了！
Other occupations like teachers, dentists, drivers, or police officers are also great jobs."
其他职业如教师、牙医、司机或警官也都是很棒的工作。」
